{{Quote|Technically, Balmorra's not a Republic world, just a Republic ''ally.'' But the Empire didn't care.|Tai Cordan commenting on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Tai Cordan''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] trade secretary of the [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran government]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he joined the [[Rift Alliance]] and with the aid of the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he became President of Balmorra to formally bring his homeworld back into the Republic. Sometime afterwards, he resigned the presidency to become Balmorra's senator.

==Biography==
When Balmorra was ceded to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Cordan was one of the few members of the government to be exiled from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and joined the [[Rift Alliance]]; during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] decided to retake his planet, so Cordan fought on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|world's liberation]], and worked with a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] to restore the Balmorran government and eliminate the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] presence. Cordan directed the Barsen'thor into gaining the support of Resistance leader [[Zenith]] and the corporations before sending the Jedi to rescue President [[Retheus Galthe]]. Unfortunately, Galthe was tortured into insanity, thus the Balmorran people decided that Cordan would inherit his office. Thus, Cordan upheld his promise to the Barsen'thor by appealing for Republic membership and sending them Balmorra's array of battle droids. He remained on Balmorra, maintaining holo-correspondence with his colleagues as the Barsen'thor traveled the galaxy assisting the Rift Alliance and unmasking the [[Children of the Emperor]].

===Post-Eternal Empire Conquest===
[[File:Tai_Cordan_captured.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Senator Cordan was captured by the Eternal Empire.]]
Sometime before or after the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the galaxy, Cordan resigned the presidency to represent Balmorra in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Later on, Cordan desired to join [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander's]] [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul, but had no idea where to find them. In searching, he came into contact with Imperial Admiral [[Zasha Ranken]] and exiled Zakuulan holo-performer [[Malita Tal]], who were also seeking to join the Alliance. Inspired by a common cause, the trio formed an alliance of their own. They were discovered and captured by the Eternal Empire and were being transported to Zakuul, as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] was convinced they knew the Outlander's whereabouts. However, their transport was [[GEMINI trap|raided]] by the Alliance in a bid to commandeer the ship.

===Possible future===
In one of his many [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of possible futures, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kutri O'a]] foresaw a descendant of Tai Cordan named Lara Cordan, who would try to found a new Rift Alliance.
